translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Winja, Yaye Nyasaye e kinde manyisi chandruokna;
rit ngimana kuom jasigu ma bwoga.
Panda ne chenro maricho mag joma richo,
panda ne koko ma oganda matimo marach goyo.
Gipiago lewgi ka ligangla
kendo gichimo wechegi ka asere motimo sum.
Gidiro asere kama giponde mondo gichwogo ngʼama onge ketho;
gibaye gi asere apoya ka gionge luoro.
Gijiwore ngʼato gi ngʼato kuom chenrogi maricho,
giwuoyo kaka ginyalo pando obadhogi,
kagiwacho niya, “En ngʼa mabiro nenogi?”
Gichano timo ne ji marach kagiwacho niya,
“Waseloso chenro malongʼo chuth!”
Kuom adier, pach dhano gi chunye opando riekni maricho miwuoro.
To Nyasaye biro bayogi gi aserni;
apoya nono, ibiro puodgi piny.
Obiro loko lewgi mi gogi gin giwegi
mi otiekgi chuth;
ji duto monenogi biro kino wigi gi wuoro.
Ji duto biro bedo maluor,
gibiro hulo tije Nyasaye,
kendo gibiro paro mos kuom gima osetimo.
Joma kare mondo obed moil kuom Jehova Nyasaye
kendo gipondo kuome;
ji duto moriere tir gie chunygi mondo opake!
